questions.prompt: What does an air filter remove from supply air?
questions.explanation: Ambient air contains contaminants; the filter cleans particles and water droplets from it.

reviewCue.text: Review C209 Pneumatic Systems.pdf, slide 22. Look for Air Filter, slide 22.
reviewCue.excerpt:
Air Filter
Function
► The air used in pneumatics is ambient air. That 
means that the air can contain dust, 
pollution, and other particles which are to 
small to see.
► If a particle is large enough it can prevent 
close fitting parts from working smoothly.
► An air filter is a device designed to clean the 
air before it enters the pneumatic system. It 
will also remove water droplets from the air 
supply. 
► All pneumatic system should be installed with 
one or more air filters to keep them working 
properly.

questions.prompt: What does a pneumatic pressure gauge indicate?
questions.explanation: System pressure. The course explains: Pressure Gauges Functionality Indicates the amount of pressure in a pneumatic system. Technicians read these gauges to determine if the machine is operating properly. Most gauges have a face plate graduated in either US customary (Psi), or Si units (Pascals). A pointer rotates around the scaled face plate as the pressure changes to indicate the pressure in the system. Pressure Gauge error Manufacturers state the error of the gauge in their catalogs as a percent of the full scale reading. A small percentage of gauge error is always possible.

questions.prompt: What is the purpose of the filter deflector plate?
questions.explanation: Spin the incoming air. The course explains: Air Filter Inlet Port – Air enters filter through inlet port. Deflector Plate – The deflector plate causes the air to spin inside the filter bowl. Filter element – The filter element traps the remaining small particles. Baffle – The baffle controls the path of the air flow. Bowl – The bowl collects the water and dirt particles and serves as the outer casing of the air filter. Manual drain – The drain plug allows the collected water and dirt particles to be drained. Water should be drained before it reaches the bottom of the baffle. Outlet Port – The air exits the filter through the outlet port. Inlet Port Outlet Port Deflector Plate Filter Element Baffle Bowl Manual Drain A01 A38

questions.prompt: What do piston seals separate in a double-acting cylinder?
questions.explanation: The two cylinder chambers. The course explains: Double-Acting Pneumatic Cylinder Piston seals – piston seals are used to separate the chambers of the cylinder. These seals allow pressure to build and reduce leakage inside the cylinder. Rod seals – A flexible seal, called a rod seal, is placed around the piston rod to prevent external leakage. Rod bushing – a bushing holds the piston in place and helps support the rod as it extends. Piston Seal Rod seal Bushing
